sites.name: Ba Om Pond (Square Pond)
sites.event: A famous scenic spot associated with the legend of a pond-digging competition between men and women to win the right to marry.

sites.name: Ang Pagoda (Angkorajaborey)
sites.event: One of the oldest and most beautiful Khmer pagodas in Tra Vinh, located within the scenic area of Ba Om Pond, featuring distinct Angkor architecture.

sites.name: Ba Dong Beach
sites.event: A long beach with unique undulating sand dunes (hence the name Ba Dong), featuring a characteristic black iron-mixed sand beach.

sites.name: Temple of President Ho Chi Minh
sites.event: Secretly built and protected by the military and people of Tra Vinh right in the heart of enemy territory during the fierce war years (inaugurated in 1971).

sites.name: Hang Pagoda (Kompong Chray)
sites.event: A unique Khmer pagoda with a gate designed like a cave, famous for its artistic wood carving workshop and natural bird sanctuary.

sites.name: Tan Quy Islet
sites.event: A rich alluvial land famous for its fruit-laden orchards (mangosteen, rambutan) located in the middle of the Hau River.

sites.name: Tra Vinh Khmer Ethnic Culture Museum
sites.event: A place that preserves, displays, and introduces more than 800 artifacts reflecting the rich cultural and spiritual life of the Southern Khmer ethnic people.

sites.name: Co Pagoda (Nodol Pagoda)
sites.event: An ancient Khmer pagoda with a spacious campus that is home to thousands of storks, herons, and cormorants... creating a fascinating natural landscape.

sites.name: Huynh Ky Ancient House
sites.event: A beautiful ancient house combining French architecture with Vietnamese-Chinese patterns, which was once the private residence of Doc phu su Huynh Ky.

sites.name: Long Tri Islet
sites.event: An eco-tourism area with a pristine cork mangrove forest and relaxing activities like boating and fishing.

sites.name: Truc Lam Tra Vinh Zen Monastery
sites.event: The first and largest Zen monastery of the Truc Lam Yen Tu sect in Tra Vinh, facing the East Sea.

sites.name: Con Tau Weapons Reception Terminal Relic (Ho Chi Minh Trail at Sea)
sites.event: An important link of the Ho Chi Minh Trail at Sea, where weapons from the North were received to support the Southern battlefield.
